integrity.claim_scope: One phase-dependent theorem for the standardized symmetric binomial and Gaussian cell quantizations.
integrity.computational_role: The included script is a finite-sample regression check; the infinite statement is analytic.

scientific_limitations: The asymptotic expansion is proved for each fixed phase and only for the symmetric binomial family.
No optimality is asserted for nonsymmetric lattice laws or divergences other than Kullback-Leibler divergence.
title: Midpoint quantization accelerates the symmetric-binomial entropic CLT by one order
